task_description: The user tested the work item peek on a phone and reported two defects in the apontamentos (work log) UI: hours still render as decimals ('32,25h' instead of '32h 15min') on the surfaces the previous change did not cover, and the layout is not responsive - labels clip, values wrap out of their boxes, and the allowance title collides with the consumed-percentage badge. Fix both, for desktop and mobile: convert every remaining user-facing hour rendering in the API to a clock duration (keeping decimal only for spreadsheet exports and raw payload fields), wire the /preview display twins the form was missing, and add responsive breakpoints across the worklog components and the peek container without altering the desktop layout.

verification.summary: RE-RUN after the SECOND semantic review (2026-08-10-211435-review.md, verdict APPROVED with 6 issues) and the fixes for its four actionable ones; the numbers below replace the previous round's. ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-api-tests.sh -q with NO marker filter and no path filter -> 2613 passed, 0 failed, 1595s (2611 before, plus the guard-reach test and the contract_balance_statement rendering test). ruff check apps/api -> 16 errors, byte-identical to FEAT-001's pre-existing list; the single one inside a touched file, test_service_log_client_app.py:174 E501, is a fixture line no round of this task edited. REBUILD=1 ./tools/agent-sandbox/run-web-checks.sh types exit 0; oxlint 0 warnings 0 errors on apps/web/core/components/service-logs (13 files). The nine container-query utilities were recompiled through the repo's own tailwindcss 4.1.17 after the thresholds moved, proving @sm = width >= 24rem (384px) and @lg = width >= 32rem (512px) really emit -- a variant that failed to compile would degrade silently to the mobile layout. Issues 5 and 6: the AST guard now walks all of plane/ except tests and migrations, names in a test the files it reaches, documents the inline-decimal blind spot it cannot cover, and the offender it used to walk past (f'{total_logged} h' in _service_log_batch_summary) renders through format_hours_human; the twin walker is now asserted on the four payloads with the worst history, /preview included, with the one deliberate exception (a client row's debited_hours) pinned as an exact list rather than left unsaid. Issue 3: the totals grid and the entry row moved from @xl (576px, exactly the side peek's container at a 1280px window, where a Firefox scrollbar decides the layout) to @lg (512px), and the text-base step from @md to @sm for the same reason at 1024px. Issue 4 is OPEN BY DESIGN: the 1024-1279 band still shows a 2x2 grid and stacked entries, which no threshold choice avoids, and the review asks the user to confirm that is wanted -- D69 now states the consequence in words instead of leaving it implicit in the arithmetic. Issues 1 (nothing deployed) and 2 (the peek shell) remain answered in writing: a sub-agent can neither push nor dispatch build-branch.yml. Found while verifying rather than by the review: the batch summary change left three audit-trail assertions still expecting the decimal notation, in test_service_log_app.py, test_service_log_permissions_app.py and test_activity_client_projection_app.py's fixture; all three now read the clock duration the code writes.
